verdict.rationale: GitLab clearly ships SAST that scans source code on each commit, but nothing in the evidence pack describes taint tracking, data-flow analysis, or cross-file and inter-procedural analysis. Generic SAST scanning is adjacent to this story and does not show taint-style detection across files and function boundaries.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can detect taint-style vulnerabilities that flow across files and function boundaries
